labels.name: enhancement
labels.rationale: Feature request: asks for new unit styling in ReprHighlighter

body:
Thanks for the suggestion. New highlighting behaviour such as styling units in `ReprHighlighter` is a feature request. Per the [feature request template](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.md), new features need to be approved in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) before an issue is opened, so please start the proposal there.

Meanwhile, you can already define your own unit highlighting by subclassing `RegexHighlighter` as described in [the highlighting docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/highlighting.rst).

Related earlier report: #3318 (number regex and separators/binary forms).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
